message.content:
This editorial illustration for the magazine TEMPO features an off-white background with various graphic elements. At the top, the red logo "TEMPO" is dominant. Below it, small black text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". In the upper right, a large red-tinted hand in a suit sleeve holds a rectangular gold frame. Emerging from this frame is a woman wearing a yellow hijab and long-sleeved shirt, holding a small green and white card. Below them, an elderly man with grey hair, dressed in a beige shirt and brown trousers, lies on the ground with one hand raised toward the frame.

The text on the left reads "Kisruh Duit Buruh," followed by a paragraph starting with "Kementerian Ketenagakerjaan menahan dana Jaminan Hari Tua buruh." Smaller text at the top left says "Manuver Memperpanjang Usia Pensiun TNI H.30" and at the top right, "Perdagangan Karbon yang Semu H.100". A barcode and date "21-27 FEBRUARI 2022" are in the bottom right corner. All human figures are rendered in a stylized, illustrative manner with flat colors and shading.
